title: Semester
description: This semester's schedule: which content weeks run, in what order, and when each unlocks.

breaks.description: Class dates with no content, such as university breaks.

reveal_time.description: Local time each week's homework unlocks, as `"HH:MM"` (24-hour).

slides_reveal_minutes_before.description: Minutes before `reveal_time` when each week's slides unlock.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the reveal time is expressed in, e.g. `"America/New_York"`.

weeks.description: The weeks shown this term, in schedule order.

Break.description: A skipped class, shown in schedule order with no slides or homework.

date.description: Calendar date of the skipped class.

name.description: Name shown in place of a week's topics, e.g. `"Fall Break"`.

ScheduledWeek.description: One entry in a semester schedule: which content week to show, and when it unlocks.

date.description: Calendar date the week's homework unlocks.

week.description: The week's slug: the file stem under `schedule/weeks/`.
